dedupe_keys.name: piani di protezione civile online multiplan

description: Piani di Protezione Civile online (MULTIPLAN) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by multiplan.servizirl.it. The new Information System Civil Protection Plans on line is addressed to the technical offices of the municipalities for the drafting and updating of plans, as part of the new interrelationships between PGT and Civil Protection Plans, as recently indicated by the new Civil Protection Code.For more information refer to the following link:. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Online Civil Protection Plans (MULTIPLAN)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include studi, idraulici, multiplan, geologici. The listing shows 2023-10-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
